name: Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness)
accessNote: 11 Chaos druid spawns in the Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon, reached past the wilderness lever/ditch. Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills, so the non-Wilderness Chaos Druid Tower, Taverley Dungeon and Yanille Agility Dungeon spawns do not count. Multicombat, cannon and safespot are not wiki-stated for this spot; conservative defaults are used.
